subject.title: fix: prevent session exports from writing outside workspace

question: Should `/export-session` and its `/export` alias permanently require configured command ownership rather than ordinary authorized-sender access?
rationale: Workspace confinement is a clear security fix, but changing the shipped command's privilege boundary affects existing helper-user configurations and requires maintainer security-policy intent.

options.title: Require command ownership
options.body: Keep the proposed owner-only gate because the export includes transcript content, the system prompt, tool schemas, and filesystem write capability.

options.title: Retain authorized-sender access
options.body: Remove the owner gate and land only workspace confinement if authorized non-owner session export is an intended supported contract.

recommendation.title: Require command ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed owner-only gate because the export includes transcript content, the system prompt, tool schemas, and filesystem write capability.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete committed the original feature and has the strongest available history across the affected command area.
